scope: All 16 emitted originals of continuation batch 08 individually viewed at original detail. Complete refers only to this review, not the full measurement or any later workflow gate.

images.notes: Light entry shows a horizontal six-sleeve probe with cable loop and tip. Opening question, factual ownership and symbolic-geometry disclaimer are readable; face text is not reliably legible.
Opening rest preserves full caption and links with the long probe above/right; the small projected faces convey little explanatory detail.
Middle separates sleeves into two groups of three, but unreadable labels do not identify command versus observation. Right group crowds the Observation navigation label; main caption remains clear.
Ending reunites the long probe beside readable 40 assembled/six bench-tested/no customers and unfinished full-qualification caveats.
Pointer before shows Dark selected with pale prose and the dark probe on a dark ground.
Pointer after visibly selects Light and changes the ground/text palette while preserving the probe and opening content.
Keyboard before visibly focuses unselected Light while Dark remains selected.
Keyboard after shows Light selected and focused with the intended pale-ground/dark-text response.
Phone Light entry fits complete opening ownership, disclaimer and links; the probe is very small and thin, with face labels unreadable.
Phone opening rest retains unclipped readable caption and horizontal probe; small geometry does not explain individual roles.
Phone middle shows two offset groups of three sleeves above complete unresolved-observation text; group identities depend on prose, not legible diagram labels.
Phone ending shows rejoined probe and readable sample/testing/customer/qualification limits plus contact links.
Phone pointer before shows Dark selected and available Light control, with readable pale opening text.
Phone pointer after visibly selects Light and changes palette without dropping the probe or opening caption.
Phone keyboard before visibly focuses Light while Dark is still selected.
Phone keyboard after shows selected/focused Light and intended palette response, with opening text and probe retained.

controlFindings: All desktop/phone pointer and keyboard trials start from actual Dark and visibly reach Light, with URL, look, palette and pressed-state changes.
Keyboard before images visibly focus Light. Reports retain five desktop and two phone Tab presses followed by Enter.
limits: Probe sleeves have physical thickness, but the thin, small projected assembly and unreadable face text provide weak command/observation mapping, especially on phone.
The middle's two groups are visibly distinct without identifying their roles independently of the prose. Desktop right group crowds the Observation rail label.
Palette response and technical completion do not establish final spatial/material/diagram quality, animation quality, author approval, physical-device acceptance or an overall gate.
provenance: Every PNG opened separately using view_image original; saved report hashes and sizes independently checked using read-only file/hash/size operations. No browser, model, test, app-runtime, cleanup, process signalling or old-artifact edits were performed.
